sourceReferences.finding: First-party CLI sends projectId, ownerId, page, startDate and endDate to the vercel.com request-logs GET endpoint. This focused source exposes no aggregate query.

An upstream issue reports page repetition and recommends bounded time cursors. The current local read probe instead observed page 1 empty despite page 0 more=true; no page-number accumulation was trusted.
